identity.summary: All approved source and Gate 2 derivative geometry remains unchanged.

palette.summary: Existing approved formal and interface colors remain unchanged.

typography.summary: Existing local fonts and outlined wordmarks remain authoritative.

platform_assets.summary: Every kit gains byte-identical descriptive logo aliases and a path map. Existing logo and icon deliveries retain their paths and bytes.

web_react.summary: The Web and React adapter API and token roles remain unchanged.

egui.summary: The egui adapter API and approved values remain unchanged.

documentation.summary: The shared asset glossary and generated guides use consistent form, layout, ink, background, and surface terms. Hosted and portable downloads show one card per distinct design.

recovery.summary: Regenerate and repin 2.5.0 kits with exact package checksums to adopt descriptive aliases and catalog metadata. Existing approved asset paths remain valid.
